findings.evidence: Grep for `le_enlarge` in TauCeti finds only the `enlarge` version at line 221; no `le_enlargeBounded` exists. Lines 224-225, 253-254, 318-319, 324-325 show the file's `rw [X_ringOfDefinition]; exact le_...` idiom being factored into a named lemma in every other case.
findings.fix: Add `le_enlargeBounded (P) (B) (hB) : P.ringOfDefinition ≤ (P.enlargeBounded B hB).ringOfDefinition` and its right counterpart `B ≤ (P.enlargeBounded B hB).ringOfDefinition` (mirroring `le_sup_left`/`le_sup_right`), state the ideal lemma as `... map (Subring.inclusion (P.le_enlargeBounded B hB))` — the body `P.enlarge_idealOfDefinition _ _ _` still closes it, since the inclusion proofs differ only proof-irrelevantly — and derive `le_sup_left`/`le_sup_right` (lines 316, 322) and line 350 from them.
findings.issue: `enlargeBounded_idealOfDefinition` builds its inclusion argument with an inline, uncommented `show P.ringOfDefinition ≤ (P.enlargeBounded B hB).ringOfDefinition by rw [enlargeBounded_ringOfDefinition]; exact le_sup_left` inside the statement. Every sibling construction names this fact instead: `le_enlarge` (line 221) for `enlarge_idealOfDefinition`, `le_adjoin` (line 250) for `adjoin_idealOfDefinition`, `le_sup_left` (line 316) for `sup_idealOfDefinition`. The same reusable fact is reconstructed a second time in the `B ≤ ...` direction as `by simp` at line 350.

findings.evidence: Line 292 `... = P.ringOfDefinition ⊔ B := (rfl)` vs line 302 `:= P.enlarge_idealOfDefinition _ _ _` and line 313 `:= P.enlargeBounded_ringOfDefinition _ _` in the same diff; `enlarge` (line 163) is a `by`-block def whose fields are only reachable by delta/zeta unfolding.
findings.fix: Prove `enlargeBounded_ringOfDefinition` as `P.enlarge_ringOfDefinition _ _ _` and `sup_idealOfDefinition` as `P.enlargeBounded_idealOfDefinition _ _`, so neither depends on the bodies of `enlarge`/`enlargeBounded`.
findings.issue: `enlargeBounded_ringOfDefinition` is proved by `(rfl)`, i.e. by unfolding `enlargeBounded`'s `letI` body and `enlarge`'s tactic-produced structure literal, although the named lemma `enlarge_ringOfDefinition` (line 216) states exactly this. The PR simultaneously moves `sup_ringOfDefinition` off `(rfl)` onto `P.enlargeBounded_ringOfDefinition _ _` (line 313), so the new declaration contradicts the robustness principle the diff itself applies. Same instance at line 331: `sup_idealOfDefinition := (rfl)` now unfolds one layer deeper than before (`sup` → `enlargeBounded` → `enlarge`) since `sup` was redefined at line 306.

summary: enlargeBounded is the only construction in this file without a named `le_` companion, so its ideal lemma embeds an undocumented `show ... by rw; exact` proof term in its own statement and the `B ≤ ...` inclusion is re-derived inline elsewhere. Its `ringOfDefinition` lemma also falls back on raw `rfl` where the existing `enlarge_ringOfDefinition` applies — the very change the PR makes to `sup_ringOfDefinition`.
